Export photos with SnapShotFinder

MB

Maximum size includes viewer, photos and saved maps. Checked before photo compression. 1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes.

Includes an extra copy of the JPGs and saved maps inside viewer-SnapShotFinder.html, so the package opens without selecting photos. JPGs still sit beside viewer-SnapShotFinder.html. The extra copy can require stronger photo compression at the same ZIP limit. Uncheck for a smaller viewer: extract the ZIP, then choose or drop its JPGs to restore saved locations. Your browser remembers this choice.

Photos are compressed and, only where necessary, resized. The originals stay unchanged. A mail server's limit for the entire message may require a smaller ZIP.

Comments

Download last comments ZIP again

Comments are saved in this browser and included in ZIP.

△ Orange: changes not yet confirmed in a saved JPG.
✓ Green circle: XMP read from the JPG or a verified saved copy.
⚠ Red: unsaved changes are not secured in browser storage.

Downloads remain orange: the browser does not report completion to this page. Reopen the saved JPGs, or use Verify saved ZIP / JPGs to check one whole downloaded ZIP. A cancelled or denied download never turns a comment green.

Save comments: with source-folder write access, update changed source JPGs. Otherwise (including Firefox), download ALL loaded photos in a Copy ZIP, regardless of filters or comments. Extract it to obtain the complete photo folder; no viewer is included. Unchanged files retain their bytes and format; changed JPGs receive XMP without image recompression. Edited non-JPGs become JPG copies. ZIP remains the filtered sharing package with viewer.

              limit does not describe all memory available to the browser.

            
The map bar shows only the additional map image cache, which is automatically bounded.

            
Delay is a responsiveness indicator. Browser scheduling and system activity also affect it.
